tagline: Throw crates and barrels over a fence to knock down a pyramid of fifteen crates with a red flag on top: score 9 points in 90 seconds.
overview:
Castle Crash is a first-person throwing game. Behind a low fence, on a sandy pad, lie six pieces of ammo: two crates, two barrels and two heavy crates (the heaviest a person can lift). Out across the field stands a castle: a pyramid of fifteen pastel crates with a red flag on top.

Pick up a piece of ammo (E), look up and press E again to throw it. Every castle crate that is knocked more than 0.8 metres or ends up on its side scores 1 point, and bringing down the flag scores 3 more. Reach 9 points within 90 seconds to win. Ammo you carry back onto the pad is given back to you. The angle matters a great deal: a lob of 16 to 19 degrees above level lands on the castle, while flatter throws fall short.
story: A siege in miniature: one thrower, six pieces of junk and a castle of crates with a red pennant on top. Knock enough of it down before the clock runs out.
goal: Score 9 points (SCORE 9) within 90 seconds: each castle crate knocked over or moved is 1 point, the flag 3 more.
rules: Pick up ammo from the pad behind the fence (E), aim up, and press E again to throw it.
Every loose object flies at most about 14 m/s, and air slows it, so only a lob reaches the castle; flat throws fall short.
A castle crate scores 1 when it has moved more than 0.8 m or lies on its side (KNOCKED).
The red flag scores 3 when it falls (FLAG_DOWN).
Carry thrown ammo back onto the pad to get it back (AMMO).

controls.action: Pick up ammo; press again to throw

characters.name: The Castle
characters.description: A pyramid of fifteen pastel crates, five wide at the bottom.

characters.name: The Flag
characters.description: The red cone on top of the castle: worth 3 points when it comes down.

characters.name: The Ammo
characters.description: Two crates, two barrels and two heavy crates on the sandy pad behind the fence.

characters.name: The Fence
characters.description: A low wooden fence you throw over.

tips: Look up a fair way before you throw: about 16 to 19 degrees above level, the castle's flag sitting just under the crosshair.
Small changes in angle make a big difference; if one throw falls short, aim a little higher next time rather than a lot.
Barrels roll after they land, which can sweep the bottom row.

Six throws later the castle is down: KNOCKED 6 and the flag fell, SCORE 9: VICTORY.

prompt: Please pull the most recent version of RedEngine. Create 3 mini games with this. The games must be unique and they must utilize physics in some way. Provide feedback per game about your experience developing with this engine.
prompt_source: Given to Claude Code on 2026-09-30, in a session working on RedEngine. That one prompt produced three games: Skyline Stacker, Castle Crash and Plate Chamber.
